description: Career-oriented pathways that connect Core Engineering foundations to Future Engineering learning paths.

pathways.title: Smart Building Systems
pathways.description: A pathway from thermal and electrical foundations to AI-supported HVAC and connected monitoring.
practiceOutcomes: Explain HVAC optimisation boundaries and assumptions.
Connect measured system data to engineering decisions.
Identify why AI-supported recommendations require review.

pathways.title: Industrial Monitoring
pathways.description: A pathway from circuits, programming, and fluids to smart pump monitoring and fault diagnosis.
practiceOutcomes: Connect flow symptoms to monitoring signals.
Identify normal, boundary, and fault states in monitored systems.

pathways.title: Robotics And Automation
pathways.description: A pathway from circuits, control, and programming to robotics foundations.
practiceOutcomes: Map feedback concepts to robotic behaviour.
Identify sensing, actuation, and safety boundaries.
Explain assumptions and limitations in robot simulations.

pathways.title: AI-Assisted Mechanical Design
pathways.description: A pathway from mechanics and programming to machine learning awareness and generative mechanical design.
targetLearners: students interested in AI-supported design workflows
practiceOutcomes: Connect material and loading foundations to generated design options.
Identify verification needs for AI-supported design.
Explain why generated options are not automatically approved engineering designs.
